purpose: Default action template for Codex Cat Hatcher realistic cat-photo pets.

style.notes: Realistic photo-derived domestic cat. Preserve the input cat's face, coat markings, eye color, ear shape, whiskers, and proportions. Avoid cartoon, sticker, plush, toy, or painterly style unless the user explicitly asks.

loopPolicy.notes: Keep all actions readable but not large. No speed lines, dust, floating tears, sparkles, shadows, text, UI, or loose artifacts.

cardinalConstraints.000: Unmistakably looking up at final 192x208 size: pitch the whole head upward, put the nose tip above head center, expose the lower muzzle/chin, lift the eyelids, and keep the original irises high inside the original eye apertures; never use a neutral/front head.
cardinalConstraints.090: Unmistakably screen-right in viewer coordinates: nose tip and visible pupils cross to the screen-right side of head center.
cardinalConstraints.180: Unmistakably looking down at final 192x208 size: bow the whole head, put the nose tip below head center, show more crown, and lower the original irises inside the original eye apertures; never use a neutral/front head.
cardinalConstraints.270: Unmistakably screen-left in viewer coordinates: nose tip and visible pupils cross to the screen-left side of head center.

sharedConstraints: Keep the paws, lower torso, apparent scale, baseline, skull width, eye spacing, and body registration fixed across directions.
Preserve the cat's original physical eye construction; redraw eye surfaces, irises, pupils, eyelids, rims, and highlights coherently instead of adding replacement or detached eyes.
Judge every cardinal at normal 192x208 display size before generating either eight-direction row.

sharedActionGroups.copyPolicy: Generate the canonical state once, then deterministically derive target rows from its approved extracted frames while adapting to each target state's required frame count.

rows.action: Cat sleeps in a compact curled/loaf-like pose with one paw covering both eyes.
rows.motion: Subtle breathing plus small paw/head movement; not every frame should look identical.
constraints: loop returns to the same sleeping pose
head on the left, tail on the right
absolutely no cast shadow, contact shadow, floor patch, grounding ellipse, ambient-occlusion patch, reflection, halo, glow, or soft pixels beneath or around the cat
flat chroma background touches the outer fur silhouette everywhere outside the cat

rows.action: Small realistic directional run or trot toward screen-right.
rows.motion: Readable alternating trot cadence through extended and compressed stride phases; preserve a stable apparent body size and baseline and never reset into a standing, sitting, or loaf pose.
constraints: all eight frames belong to one coherent gait cycle

rows.action: Small realistic directional run or trot toward screen-left.
rows.motion: Derive by mirroring clean extracted running-right frames when the cat has no asymmetric props.
constraints: overwrite transparent pixels when patching atlas rows

rows.action: Cat sits or stands and gives a small cute paw wave.
rows.motion: Paw raises, waves slightly, then returns.
constraints: final frame returns near first frame

rows.action: Cat sits or stands and gives a small cute paw wave.
rows.motion: Paw raises, waves slightly, then returns.
constraints: final frame returns near first frame

rows.action: Cat makes a sad or crying face.
rows.motion: Gradual expression change, drooped ears/head, and subtle body sink, followed by a smooth return to the opening pose.
constraints: tears must stay attached to the face/fur silhouette
keep apparent body size, head size, torso width, and baseline stable throughout the loop
do not redraw the cat progressively larger or smaller during the slump

rows.action: Cat shows off belly or stares at the user expectantly.
rows.motion: Small blink, tiny head movement, or gentle belly pose shift.

rows.action: Active working state: cat sits and licks fur.
Cat holds a small focused cute review pose.
rows.motion: Small blink, head tilt, or attentive posture shift.
constraints: no magnifier, papers, code, or UI props

rows.action: First half of 16-direction look loop: 000 through 157.5 degrees.
rows.motion: Rotate gaze/head/body direction while preserving identity.
constraints: 000 is unmistakably up at final 192x208 size: whole head pitches upward, nose is above head center, lower muzzle and chin are exposed, original irises are high inside the original eye apertures, and eyelids lift; never neutral/front
screen-right yaw increases monotonically from 000 through 090
after 090, downward pitch increases monotonically through 157.5 toward 180
keep paws, lower torso, apparent scale, baseline, skull width, and eye spacing fixed

rows.action: Second half of 16-direction look loop: 180 through 337.5 degrees.
constraints: 180 is unmistakably down at final 192x208 size: whole head bows, nose is below head center, more crown is visible, and the original irises sit low inside the original eye apertures; never neutral/front
202.5 through 337.5 remain on the screen-left side of head center until the 000 boundary
use one monotonic screen-left yaw trajectory: 202.5 slight, 225 moderate, 247.5 strong, 270 maximum, 292.5 strong, 315 moderate, 337.5 slight
rise gradually from maximum down at 180 to level at 270 and then toward the approved 000-up pose
keep paws, lower torso, apparent scale, baseline, skull width, and eye spacing fixed
